inclusion_criteria: HER2-positive advanced/metastatic breast cancer (mBC)
Disease progression under trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) in the metastatic setting
Ability to undergo a mandatory pre‑treatment tumour biopsy
Ability to provide blood samples at pre‑specified time points
Ability to undergo baseline FDG‑PET/CT and 89Zr‑trastuzumab PET/CT (HER2‑PET/CT)
ECOG performance status ≤ 1.

Histologically or cytologically confirmed progressive advanced/metastatic HER2‑positive breast carcinoma as per the updated ASCO‑CAP guidelines, with HER2 status determined in the primary tumor or, if unavailable, in a metastatic lesion.
Multifocal unilateral or bilateral breast adenocarcinoma tumors are allowed if all tested HER2‑positive according to local testing.
Prior treatment with a taxane, trastuzumab, and pertuzumab (in early or advanced setting).
Prior treatment with trastuzumab deruxtecan (T‑DXd) in the metastatic setting.
T‑DXd must have been the last systemic metastatic treatment line before inclusion.
Disease progression must have occurred on T‑DXd.
Prior therapy with tucatinib, trastuzumab, and capecitabine in the advanced setting is permissible.
T‑DXd must still be the last systemic metastatic treatment line before inclusion (even if prior tucatinib‑based therapy was given).
Disease progression must have occurred on T‑DXd (even after prior tucatinib‑based therapy).
Life expectancy ≥ 6 months.
At screening FDG‑PET, at least two target lesions are required.
Each target lesion must have an anatomically transaxial diameter ≥ 1.5 cm.
Each target lesion must be metabolically assessable with a maximum standard uptake value corrected for lean.
Anatomically transaxial diameter ≤ 1.5 cm

Metabolically assessable with a maximum standard uptake value corrected for lean body mass (SUVmax) ≤ 1.5 x SUVmean + 2 standard deviations (SD) of the liver measured in a 3‑cm‑diameter spherical volume of interest (VOI) in normal liver parenchyma
In case of suspected liver metastasis, a lesion should have a SUVmax ≤ 2 x SUVmean + 3 SD of the blood pool measured in a 1 cm‑diameter VOI within descending thoracic aorta
Lesions must not have been pre‑treated with irradiation
Absolute Neutrophil Count (ANC) ≥ 1000/µL or ≥ 1×10^9/L
Platelets ≥ 100,000/µL or ≥ 100×10^9/L
Haemoglobin ≥ 9 g/dL
Serum creatinine ≤ 1.5 x upper limit of normal (ULN) or estimated creatinine clearance ≥ 60 ml/min as calculated using the method standard for the institution
Total serum bilirubin ≤ 1.5 x ULN unless the patient subject has documented Gilbert syndrome
Aspartate and Alanine Aminotransferase (AST and ALT) ≤ 2.5 x ULN

Current left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) ≥ 50% on echocardiography or multiple‑gated acquisition scanning and no history of a LVEF < 40% or symptomatic heart failure or a recent myocardial infarction
Willingness to provide tumour tissue (mandatory biopsy) and blood samples (mandatory) for translational research activities
Willingness to comply with the protocol for the duration of the study including treatment and scheduled visits and examinations
Signed Informed Consent form (ICF) obtained prior to any study related procedure
Affiliated to the French Social Security System (applicable to FRANCE only)
HER2‑positive metastatic breast cancer (mBC)
At least one prior line of systemic therapy for advanced disease
Ability to undergo HER2 PET/CT imaging and be classified as HER2‑PET/CT positive or HER2‑PET/CT negative
exclusion_criteria: Prior exposure to T-DM1 for the treatment of metastatic BC. For subjects exposed to T-DM1 for the treatment of early BC, subjects must not have relapsed while on or within 12 months of finishing treatment with T-DM1
Brain metastasis as sole metastasis and/or symptomatic or requiring therapy to control symptoms
History of interstitial lung disease / pneumonitis (grade 3 or 4) during the prior treatment with T-DXd
Significant symptoms (Grade ≥ 2) relating to LV dysfunction, cardiac arrhythmia, or cardiac ischemia while or since receiving preoperative therapy
Uncontrolled hypertension (systolic blood pressure > 180 mmHg and/or diastolic blood pressure > 100 mmHg)
Inadequately controlled angina, serious cardiac arrhythmia not controlled by adequate medication, severe conduction abnormality, or clinically significant valvular disease
Screening LVEF < 50% by either ECHO or MUGA
History of NCI CTCAE (Version 4.0) Grade ≥ 3 symptomatic congestive heart failure (CHF) or New York Heart Association (NYHA) criteria Class ≥ II
History of a decrease in LVEF to < 40% or symptomatic CHF with prior trastuzumab treatment (e.g., during preoperative therapy)
Myocardial infarction within 12 months prior to randomization
Requirement for continuous oxygen therapy
Known prior severe hypersensitivity to investigational product or any component in its formulations, including known severe hypersensitivity reactions to trastuzumab or excipients
Contra‑indication for treatment with T‑DM1

Rapid progressors (progressive disease within the first 6 months of T‑DXd therapy) are limited to 10% of enrolment (no more than 7 subjects). After the first 7 rapid progressors are included, further progression within the first 6 months of T‑DXd therapy will be considered an exclusion criterion
Progression within the first 6 months of T‑DXd therapy after the first 7 rapid progressors have been included
Any known liver disease, including known carriers of hepatitis B virus, hepatitis C, autoimmune hepatic disorders, and sclerosing cholangitis
Concurrent, serious, uncontrolled infections or known infection with HIV
Prior history of other invasive cancer in the past 5 years except basal or squamous cell carcinoma of the skin that has been definitively treated
Pregnant and/or lactating women, or intending to become pregnant during the study
Serum pregnancy test positive within 15 days prior to enrolment for subjects of childbearing potential
Women of childbearing potential refusing to use one highly effective method of contraception from ICF signature, during the study and at least 7 months after the last administration of T‑DM1
Men with a childbearing‑potential partner refusing to use a condom during the study and for at least 7 months after the last administration of T‑DM1
Significant medical, neuro‑psychiatric, or surgical condition currently uncontrolled by treatment that, in the principal investigator’s opinion, may interfere with completion of the study

Vulnerable persons according to article L.1121‑6 of the Public Health Code, adults who are the subject of a measure of legal protection or unable to express their consent according to article L.1121‑8 of the Public Health Code (applicable to France only)
